reasoning: This is a mixed repo. The root Go module (github.com/llm-d/llm-d-kv-cache, pkg/kvcache, pkg/kvevents, pkg/tokenization) is a library: the KV-Cache Indexer used by the llm-d inference scheduler for KV-cache-aware routing. The README says that indexer has moved to llm-d-router, and the root Dockerfile only builds an example binary. What RHOAI actually builds and ships from this checkout is deployable services, built by the Konflux/Tekton pipelines: (1) the PVC Evictor (kv_connectors/pvc_evictor/go, image quay.io/rhoai/odh-llm-d-kv-pvc-evictor-rhel9, which has a v3-7-ea-1 push pipeline), a long-running workload that watches disk usage and deletes vLLM KV-cache files on PVCs, with Helm and k8s deploy manifests; and (2) the UDS tokenizer gRPC service (services/uds_tokenizer, built by the odh-llm-d-kv-cache pipeline). The repo defines no CRDs and has no controller/reconciler, so it is not an operator. It also ships an llmd_fs_backend vLLM KV connector Python package. Because the delivered artifacts are runnable service containers, it is classified as a service, with a large embedded library part.
